strategies.name: Repeated Masked All-Reduce Chain
strategies.desc: Executes 8 sequential all-reduce operations where each rank selectively zeroes blocks outside its rank-dependent window before reduction, then applies per-block scaling factors. This is the baseline structure from the seed library with 8 all-reduce dispatches and requires buffer allocation and masking per iteration, trading dispatch count for conceptual simplicity.

strategies.name: Fused Window-Compute Single All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Pre-computes all 8 window configurations and their cumulative coverage counts locally, applies all masking/scaling logic in a single fused local computation, then performs exactly 1 final all-reduce on the weighted result. Minimizes dispatches (1 AR) at the cost of more complex local computation and potentially losing incremental refinement structure.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Block-Group Reduction
strategies.desc: Groups the 5 blocks into subsets based on coverage overlap patterns across the 8 dependency layers, performs parallel all-reduce on independent block groups, then merges results. Uses 3-5 all-reduce dispatches depending on parallelizable block groupings, balancing dispatch count against exploiting block-level independence in the dependency graph.

strategies.name: Pipelined Reduce-Scatter All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather phases across 224 ranks, enabling pipeline overlap between consecutive dependency layers. Uses 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but allows better network utilization through smaller per-dispatch payloads and latency hiding across the 8-layer dependency chain.

strategies.name: Block-Cyclic Distribution with Targeted Broadcast
strategies.desc:
Distributes ownership of the 5 blocks cyclically across rank subgroups, performs local windowed accumulation, then uses selective broadcast or all-to-all to redistribute results only to ranks that need each block. Uses 2-3 all-reduce plus 5 broadcast/gather operations (7-8 total dispatches), optimizing for reduced data movement when block coverage is sparse.
